attacks_claim.attack_type: distribution-shift (covariate shift between calibration and test sets, induced by environment-domain partition instead of the receipt's material-bucket-parity partition of the SAME held-out rows)
attacks_claim.refutation_criterion: Observed test coverage significantly below (one-sided exact binomial test, alpha=0.05) the receipt's stated 0.90 or 0.80 target in either calibration/deployment direction.
attacks_claim.target_statement: Group-safe (leave-material-out) split conformal delivers distribution-free marginal coverage at the 0.90 and 0.80 targets on the rights-clean NIST CORR-DATA corrosion-rate model.
attacks_claim.theoretical_basis: Tibshirani, Barber, Candes, Ramdas 2019 NeurIPS 'Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift': split-conformal marginal coverage requires cal/test exchangeability and is NOT robust to covariate shift without likelihood-ratio reweighting.

dataset.name: NIST CORR-DATA (Dow Chemical Co.) derived reference

determinism.binomial_test: exact log-space stdlib implementation (no scipy dependency)

scope_honesty: Bare-metal/alloy substrate corrosion (same ceiling as corr-rate-qspr-v1 / corr-rate-conformal-v1). AUDIT_ONLY: does not flip scientific_readiness, does not modify the manifest (66/11 untouched), grants no coating-barrier ranking authority.

shared_train_split.note: train materials IDENTICAL to corr-rate-conformal-v1 group_split (bucket 2,3,4); only cal/test ASSIGNMENT of the held-out rows (buckets 0+1) is changed, from material-bucket parity to environment domain (marine/chloride vs not).

verdict.finding: The corr-rate-conformal-v1 'distribution-free marginal coverage' claim does NOT survive a realistic environment-domain cal/test partition of the SAME held-out rows: at least one direction (calibrate-on-one-environment-regime, deploy-on-the-other) shows observed coverage significantly below the receipt's stated target (one-sided binomial p<0.05). The prior receipt's Mondrian marine stratification used cal and test marine subsets drawn from the SAME material-bucket partition (approximately exchangeable by construction) and so never exercised this failure mode.
